changelog:
- Operates Vultr through an OOMOL-connected account using the `oo` CLI and server-side credential injection.
- Provides read actions for account details, instances, DNS domains/records, firewall groups, OS images, plans, regions, and snapshots.
- Supports VPS lifecycle operations including instance creation, updates, power management, and deletion.
- Requires live schema inspection before running actions so payloads match the connector contract.
- Includes safety guidance for write and destructive actions, plus first-time setup troubleshooting for auth, connection, and billing issues.

Source: `oomol-lab/skills@00cf041`
summary: Vultr (vultr.com). Use this skill for ANY Vultr request — reading, creating, updating, and deleting data. Whenever a task involves Vultr, use this skill instead of calling the API directly.
